# shadcn CLI: migrate and migrate icons

## migrate Command

**Syntax:**
```
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest migrate [migration]
```

The migrate command supports several migration types accessible via a table listing migration names and descriptions.

## migrate icons

**Syntax:**
```
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest migrate icons
```

**Supported Icon Libraries:**
The documentation states that "The following libraries are supported: `lucide`, `tabler`, `hugeicons`, `phosphor`, `remixicon` and `radix` (legacy)."

**What It Changes:**
According to the guide, this operation will:
- Move components from one icon library to another
- Rewrite icon imports and JSX usage in your `ui` directory
- Install the target library
- Update `iconLibrary` in your `components.json` for future installs

**Flags & Options:**

Non-interactive mode uses `--from` and `--to` flags:
```
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest migrate icons --from lucide --to phosphor --yes
```

Scoped migrations support file or glob patterns without updating `components.json`:
```
npx shadcn@latest migrate icons "src/components/**" --from lucide --to tabler
```

**Important Caveat:**
"Icons without an equivalent in the target library are left untouched and reported at the end of the migration."

No mention of custom registries appears in the provided content.

## Decisions in force

These are settled. Apply them; don't relitigate them mid-migration.

1. **Ramp-first authoring.** Migrated components speak only ramp vocabulary
   (`bg-gray-100`, `border-gray-alpha-400`, `text-gray-900`,
   `bg-background-100`), never shadcn aliases (`bg-muted`, `text-foreground`,
   …). The aliases remain wired in `globals.css` as a compatibility layer for
   not-yet-migrated components only.
2. **Controls are flat.** Vega's `shadow-xs`/`shadow-sm` on controls is
   rejected; the border/wash carries the edge. Elevation exists only on
   floating surfaces, and only as a `material-*` utility, never a bare
   `shadow-*` class.
3. **Focus: the shadcn halo, kept, in gray, spelled in ramp vocabulary.**
   One signature for every control, click or text-entry:
   `focus-visible:border-gray-600 focus-visible:ring-3
focus-visible:ring-gray-600/50`: the solid gray-600 border for the crisp
   edge, the translucent 3px halo for the glow. This is a pure rename of
   shadcn's `focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3
focus-visible:ring-ring/50` cluster (`--ring` already resolves to
   `--ds-gray-600`), so migration changes focus vocabulary, never focus
   pixels. There are no focus tokens. The `/50` is deliberate state opacity
   (decision 5's carve-out), never swapped for a `gray-alpha-*` step; the
   halo stays derived from the border color, and no alpha tier has a halo
   role. An offset ring was prototyped on the pilot and rejected; don't
   revisit.
4. **Radius: keep the generic `rounded-*` scale.** No semantic shape tokens.
   The scale resolves through `--radius: 0.875rem` (Large); migration never
   changes a component's radius classes unless they visibly break on
   `/preview`, and that's a stop-and-resolve, not a silent fix.
5. **Hover steps the ramp, never opacity-mixes.** `hover:bg-x/80` and
   `color-mix()` hovers are replaced by the adjacent hand-tuned ramp step.
6. **Fields rest on the page surface.** Field-style controls (input,
   textarea, select/native-select triggers, combobox chips, input-group,
   input-otp slots, unchecked checkbox/radio/questionnaire indicators,
   button-group text) carry `bg-background-100` in **both** themes: the
   X-style flat field, no wash. (Reversed 2026-09-20: the earlier
   `bg-gray-alpha-400/30` wash was replaced at the human's direction.)
7. **Light and dark share the same token names.** Theming happens underneath
   the ramp; migration never adds `dark:` color overrides; if a component
   seems to need one, stop and resolve.
8. **No press animation on buttons.** Vega's `active:*translate-y-px` nudge
   (the button shifting down when pressed) is rejected; delete it wherever it
   appears. With no transform left to animate, narrow `transition-all` on
   controls to `transition-colors` (or drop it if nothing transitions).
   Functional motion is unaffected: switch thumb travel, accordion collapse,
   overlay enter/exit stay as shipped.
9. **One text inset per height: 12px, 16px at 40.** Every control at 32
   and 36px sits its text 12px in (`px-3`), 10px at 24px (`px-2.5`), 16px
   at 40px (`px-4`, x.com's field number): buttons square or pill (no
   padding compounds; `shape="rounded"` changes only the radius), toggles,
   fields (input, textarea, select and native-select triggers, input-group,
   button-group text, combobox chips). Icon sides sit a half step in
   (`ps-2.5`, `ps-3.5` at lg). Popup contents carry `p-1` plus

description: ziiz moved from hugeicons to @tabler/icons-react on 2026-09-27; no icon wrapper, chevron-vs-arrow convention, and how the migration was done

On 2026-09-27 every icon in ziiz moved from `@hugeicons/*` to
`@tabler/icons-react` (components/ui, docs primitives, examples, business-x
clone, showcase pages, MDX snippets). `components/icons` (the lucide-named
shim over hugeicons glyphs) was deleted; files import Tabler names
directly. `iconLibrary` in apps/www/components.json is `tabler`. The
decision is recorded as decision 10 in the migrate-component skill and
rule 12 in the ziiz skill.

**Why:** hugeicons was only shadcn init's default; Tabler is the chosen
library, its icons are plain components (no `<HugeiconsIcon icon={}>`
indirection), and its default stroke of 2 matches what ziiz already set
everywhere.

**How to apply:**
- Hugeicons `ArrowX01` and unnumbered `ArrowX` glyphs were chevrons, so
  disclosure, sub-menu, pagination, breadcrumb, carousel and calendar
  arrows are `IconChevron*`; `IconArrow*` only where direction is real
  (message-scroller). Toast/sonner use outline `IconCircleCheck`,
  `IconInfoCircle`, `IconAlertTriangle`, `IconCircleX`, spokes `IconLoader`.
- Recipe: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest migrate icons --from hugeicons --to
  tabler --yes` handles components/ui but skips a few glyphs and turns
  `ArrowRight01Icon` into `IconArrowRight` (fix to chevron by hand). A
  TS-AST codemod covered the other ~140 files; a `.map((icon) =>` param
  becomes `ItemIcon` so it can sit in tag position; `strokeWidth={2}` is
  dropped, other values become `stroke={n}`.
- packages/theme 0.1.2 swapped the prose `details` marker path to Tabler's
  chevron so summaries match select and accordion.
- Remaining, uncommitted at the time of writing: Nafis commits himself
  ([[no-commit-or-pr-unless-asked]]).

content.text:
Done. Every icon in ziiz now comes from `@tabler/icons-react`, and hugeicons is gone from the repo. Nothing is committed.

**What changed**

- `components/ui`: the shadcn CLI (`migrate icons --from hugeicons --to tabler`) rewrote 20 files and set `iconLibrary` to `tabler` in components.json. It skipped four glyphs it could not map, which I converted by hand in calendar, message-scroller, sonner and toast.
- Everything else (138 files: examples, docs primitives, business-x clone, showcase pages, playground) went through a TypeScript-AST codemod. The `components/icons` shim is deleted; files import Tabler names directly. Callback params like `.map((icon) =>` became `ItemIcon` so they can sit in tag position.
- MDX: 23 manual-install blocks now list `@tabler/icons-react`, and the doc snippets that still used lucide-style names (`SearchIcon`, `XIcon`, `PanelLeftIcon`…) use Tabler names.
- `@ziiz/theme` bumped to 0.1.2: the prose `details` marker path is now Tabler's chevron so summaries match select and accordion. CHANGELOG updated.
- Skills: decision 10 in migrate-component and rule 12 in the ziiz skill record the library, the `iconLibrary` setting, and the stroke convention. Registry rebuilt.

**Judgment calls worth a glance**

- The CLI mapped hugeicons `ArrowRight01` (a chevron) to `IconArrowRight`. I corrected breadcrumb, menu sub-triggers, pagination, nav and carousel back to `IconChevronRight` to preserve the current look.
- Toast and sonner use outline `IconCircleCheck` and `IconCircleX`, not the filled or octagon variants the CLI picked. Spinner keeps the eight-spoke `IconLoader`, which matches the old glyph.
- A few lucide names had no exact Tabler twin: `AudioLines` → `IconWaveSine`, `ListFilter` → `IconFilter`, `GalleryVerticalEnd` → `IconStack2`. The full table is in the codemod's mapping if you want to revisit any.
- `strokeWidth={2}` was dropped everywhere since it is Tabler's default; business-x's 1.5 became `stroke={1.5}`.

**Verified**

- `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm docs:check`, `pnpm format:check` and a full `pnpm build` all pass.
- The rebuilt registry has no hugeicons references; 27 items now declare `@tabler/icons-react`.
- Playwright screenshots of the built select, breadcrumb, sidebar and business-x pages render Tabler glyphs at the expected size. I did not exercise interactive states such as an open toast or menu.
